concerns.text: Principle II (Verified Accuracy) is violated: the plan references “Nørskov et al.” in the Descriptor‑Based Model Interpretability section but provides no verifiable citation (DOI, URL, or title) and thus the Reference‑Validator cannot confirm the source. A proper, verifiable citation must be added to satisfy the constitution.

The plan validates the final report against `contracts/report_schema.json.schema.yaml` (FR‑007) but never references the `contracts/feature_importance.schema.yaml` which defines the SHAP ranking format. Either add a validation step for `shap_rankings.csv` against this contract or remove the unused contract to keep documentation consistent.
